blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The civil society-led Truth Commission is working on building a registry that could provide a more harmonized number of the killings in the so-called war on drugs waged by former President Rodrigo Duterte. To do this, the commission on Tuesday called on the victims’ families to join the registry, and on organizations, lawyers, as well as journalists and researchers to share their records of the killings, as the death toll of Duterte’s policy against narcotics remains inconsistent.
